title: Airbnb Hosts Can No Longer Ask Guests to Clean
paragraphs: Many people who stay in Airbnb homes have had the same experience. Before they leave, they find a long list of jobs to do, such as washing the dishes, removing the sheets from the beds and taking out the trash. Now, Airbnb says these lists must stop.

In October 2026, Airbnb announced new rules for hosts, the people who rent out their homes on the website. The rules apply to bookings made on or after November 20, 2026, and they cover Airbnb homes around the world.

Under the new rules, hosts cannot require guests to do tasks that "require significant effort or time." According to Airbnb, jobs such as removing sheets from beds, taking trash away from the home and washing dishes should be done by a cleaner, not by guests.

The change comes after many guests complained that they were asked to do chores even though they were also paying a cleaning fee. Hosts can still charge cleaning fees. However, they cannot charge guests extra because they did not do a certain job.

Hosts can still make some rules, but the rules must be reasonable. For example, in some places, guests may need to handle outdoor trash carefully because of wild animals. In addition, hosts must show all their rules and requests on the listing before guests book, and they cannot add new ones later.
Listings that break the rules may show a warning to guests, saying that the home "includes cleaning requests." Hosts can appeal if they think the warning is wrong.
